nodes.author: FizeekBio
nodes.text:
@AdvancedTweaker With influenza, RSV, HMPV, mycoplasma pneumoniae, norovirus, and a panoply of other pathogens outside of SARS-CoV-2 to contend with, even access to coronavirus-specific mAbs doesn't preclude infectious disease affliction.

Hence why I remain a bubble boy.

nodes.author: AdvancedTweaker
nodes.text:
Yup. That's where I'm coming from myself too. It just feels gross for me at this point to directly contact pathogens from others' mouths after already having masked for so long. Like a socially uncomfortable comfort thing I can't let go of. 

If I get access, I'd use mAbs to strengthen my immune system and might relax a bit more. I will never stop masking 99% of the time though.
